likes_count.label: Song Popularity (Likes)
likes_count.description: Total likes this song has received across all users

user_play_count.label: Your Play History
user_play_count.description: How many times you have played this song before

skip_count.label: Your Skip History
skip_count.description: How many times you have skipped this song (negative signal)

completion_rate.label: Average Listen Completion
completion_rate.description: Average fraction of the song you listen to (0–1)

genre_language_match.label: Language Match
genre_language_match.description: 1 if this song's language matches your most-listened language

decade_match.label: Era Match
decade_match.description: 1 if this song's decade matches your preferred music era

content_similarity_score.label: Audio Similarity
content_similarity_score.description: Cosine similarity to the seed song used for content-based recommendations (0 if not a content-based rec, or 0 for all historical rows where the serving tier was not logged — see README.md).

popularity_score.label: Global Popularity
popularity_score.description: Log-normalized global play count of this song across all users

recency_days.label: Days Since You Last Listened
recency_days.description: How many days have passed since your last interaction with this song (higher = older)

tier_used_collaborative_filtering.label: Recommended by: Collaborative Filtering
tier_used_collaborative_filtering.description: This recommendation came from the ALS collaborative filtering model

tier_used_content_based.label: Recommended by: Audio Similarity
tier_used_content_based.description: This recommendation came from the content-based similarity model

tier_used_popular.label: Recommended by: Popularity
tier_used_popular.description: This recommendation came from the popular songs fallback

tier_used_unknown.label: Tier: Not Logged (Historical)
tier_used_unknown.description: The recommendation-serving tier was not logged for this historical interaction. All rows in the initial training dataset have this value. Once recommendation-serving events are logged, this field will be replaced by the actual tier (see README.md — Future Improvement).
